question: Is SOURCE_BIND -> CONTROLLED_TRANSITION -> OUTPUT_IDENTITY_CEILING an independently recurring hidden machine, an inherited JANUS governance kernel, or a mixture of independent reinvention and transfer?
null_hypotheses: H0_TEMPLATE: the sequence is primarily produced by common JANUS authoring/governance templates
H0_GENERIC: the sequence is so generic that matched non-target domains instantiate it at comparable rates
H0_LEXICAL: operator detection is substantially driven by recurring registry vocabulary rather than functional mechanism
alternative_hypothesis: H1_RECURRENT_FUNCTION: after removing shared vocabulary and tracing transfer paths, multiple domains still implement the same functional machine with domain-specific inputs, transitions and claim ceilings.

required_gates.G0_ENUMERATE_ALL_DOMAINS: Enumerate every recognized domain currently supporting the exact R3 sequence; do not privilege PALOMAR/MUSIC/GENESIS.
required_gates.G1_SOURCE_SUPPORT: For each domain, identify at least two distinct artifact lineages where possible and retain exact source paths and SHA-256 bindings.
required_gates.G2_META_LINEAGE: Search support documents for explicit references to the other domains, shared parents, common templates, generated derivatives and chronological transfer opportunities.
required_gates.G3_FUNCTIONAL_MAPPING: Map each support to SOURCE_BIND, CONTROLLED_TRANSITION and OUTPUT_IDENTITY_CEILING without relying on the operator names as evidence.
required_gates.G4_MATCHED_CONTROLS: Treat non-target domains carrying the same sequence as controls against special-target exclusivity.
required_gates.G5_ORIGIN_CLASSIFICATION: Classify each domain relation as TRANSFER_PLAUSIBLE, INDEPENDENT_ORIGIN_PLAUSIBLE, MIXED_OR_OPEN; never infer independence solely from distinct filenames or lineage keys.

scoring_policy.chronological_precedence_without_transfe: supportive but not proof of independent origin
scoring_policy.presence_in_many_domains: penalty against special PALOMAR-MUSIC-GENESIS exclusivity; may support governance-kernel recurrence

claim_ceiling: R3.3 may classify provenance/origin evidence and recurrent functional structure; it may not claim a shared physical cause, external sender, or independent invention without positive provenance separation evidence.
next_if_pass: R3.4 held-out external-domain test outside JANUS authoring lineage.
next_if_kernel: Promote the sequence only as a JANUS governance kernel and explicitly demote any special PALOMAR-MUSIC-GENESIS interpretation.
